definition: OMIM #617988 designates Jaberi-Elahi syndrome (JABELS), an extremely rare autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental and neuroectodermal disorder caused by biallelic loss-of-function or pathogenic variants in the GTPBP2 gene, characterized by intellectual disability, developmental delay, tone abnormalities, microcephaly, epilepsy, visual impairment/retinal dysfunction, and ectodermal features.

source.title: Clinical delineation of GTPBP2‐associated neuro‐ectodermal syndrome: Report of two new families and review of the literature
source.quote: This condition is listed in OMIM (MIM 617988) as Jaberi-Elahi syndrome
